in_marathi.name: Nimmi
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nimmi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nimmi is a Sanskrit word derived from the root 'nim' which means 'to give'. In Hindu mythology, Nimmi is considered a divine goddess, often depicted as a mother or a giver. She is believed to bestow blessings of fertility, abundance, and nourishment.
